sentences.text: Neutral Citation No. - 2023:AHC:203012 Court No. - 86 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 30434 of 2023 Applicant :- Dushyant And Another Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Sunil Dubey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Jeetendra Kumar Sharma Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned AGA for the State, Shri Jitendra Kumar Sharma,
learned counsel for the opposite party nos.2 & 3 and perused the record.
2.

Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that applicants and the opposite party nos.2 & 3 are next door neighbours and on account of some misunderstanding and misgivings, the instant criminal case was instituted against the applicants, however subsequently, with the intervention of respected members of both the family, the parties have amicably and genuinely settled their all disputes and now, they do not have any grievance against each other.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicants has next drawn the attention of the Court to the settlement agreement dated 15.07.2023 drawn between the parties, a copy of which has been annexed as Annexure 6 to this application.

4. Learned counsel for the applicants has next submitted that in view of the said settlement agreement drawn between the parties and in order to maintain harmonious and cordial relations between them, the entire proceedings be quashed.

5. Learned counsel for the opposite party nos.2 & 3 has also appeared and has filed affidavit on behalf of opposite party nos.2 & 3 and in para 4 of the said affidavit, it has been categorically stated that on account of some misunderstanding, the present criminal case was instituted against the applicants.
Further in para 5, settlement agreement drawn between the parties has been acknowledged.

Further in para 6, it has been stated that opposite party no.2 & 3 do not want to further prosecute the applicants and they have no objection, if the entire proceedings are quashed.
6.
Learned AGA could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

7. This Court is not unmindful of the judgements of the Hon?ble Apex Court in the cases of:-
(i). B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another, (2003) 4 SCC 675.

sentences.text: Wherein Hon'ble Apex Court has categorically held that compromise can be made between the parties even in respect of certain cognizable and non-compoundable offences.

Reference may also be made to the decision given by this Court in Shaifullah and others Vs. State of U.P. and another [2013 (83) ACC 278], in which, law expounded by Hon'ble Apex Court in the aforesaid cases has been explained in detail.

sentences.text: 9. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, as noted herein above, and also the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, this Court is of the considered opinion that no useful purpose would be served by prolonging the proceedings of the instant case.

10. Accordingly, the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 5477 of 2018 (State Vs. Nijul and Another), arising out of Case Crime No. 86 of 2018, under Sections 376, 511, 506 IPC, Police Station Gangoh, District Saharanpur, pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-IV,
Saharanpur, are hereby quashed.
